# Set up a home‑assistant chatbot with NVIDIA ChatRTX on your PC

Turn your Windows PC into a helpful home assistant that can answer questions, control smart lights, and keep a daily journal — all without sending your data to the cloud.

## Before you start
- A Windows PC with at least **8 GB of RAM** and **20 GB of free disk space**.
- An **NVIDIA GPU** (GTX 1650 or better; RTX cards work best).
- A **free NVIDIA account** at [https://www.nvidia.com](https://www.nvidia.com).
- Roughly **20 minutes** of your time.

> ⚠️ ChatRTX is free for personal use. Some advanced features may need an RTX GPU.

---

## Step 1 — Download the ChatRTX installer
Open your web browser and go to the official NVIDIA ChatRTX page. Look for a button like **Download for Windows** or **Get ChatRTX**. Click it to start the download.

After you click, the installer file (usually named something like `ChatRTX_Setup.exe`) will begin downloading. When the download finishes, open the file from your **Downloads** folder.

You'll know it worked when you see the installer window open on your screen.

💬 Example:
> If you don’t see the installer, check your browser’s download list or your Downloads folder.

---

## Step 2 — Run the installer and agree to the terms
Double-click the installer file you just downloaded. A window will appear asking you to accept the license agreement. Read it if you like, then tick the box that says **I accept the terms** and click **Install**.

The installer will copy files and set up the program. This can take a few minutes. When it’s done, you’ll see a message that says **Installation Complete**.

You'll know it worked when the installer closes and you see a shortcut on your desktop called **NVIDIA ChatRTX**.

💬 Example:
> If the installer asks for admin rights, click **Yes** to continue.

---

## Step 3 — Launch ChatRTX and sign in
Double-click the **NVIDIA ChatRTX** shortcut on your desktop. A window will open with a sign-in button. Click it and enter the email and password for your NVIDIA account.

After you sign in, the app will open to a chat window. You’ll see a welcome message and a blinking cursor ready for your first message.

You'll know it worked when you see the chat prompt and can type a message.

💬 Example:
> If the sign-in button is missing, look for a small person icon in the top-right corner.

---

## Step 4 — Pick your assistant model
In the top-left corner of the ChatRTX window, click the dropdown that says **Select Model**. Choose **mistral-7b-instruct-v0.2.Q4_K_M** (a small but capable model) or **llama-3-8b-instruct.Q4_K_M** if you prefer.

The model will load — this can take a minute. When it’s ready, the chat window will show a message like **Model loaded**.

You'll know it worked when the model name appears in the corner and the chat prompt is active.

💬 Example:
> If the dropdown is greyed out, close and reopen the app.

---

## Step 5 — Teach it about your home
In the chat box, type:
💬 Example:
> "Remember: I live in a two-bedroom apartment in Sydney. I have a Philips Hue light in the living room and a Google Nest thermostat. My daily routine is wake up at 7am, leave for work at 8:30am, and return at 6pm."

The assistant will reply with a summary of what it learned. It will now remember these details for future chats.

You'll know it worked when the assistant confirms it understands your home setup.

---

## Step 6 — Ask your first question
Type a real question into the chat box, like:
💬 Example:
> "What time should I leave to get to Bondi Junction by 9am if I walk to the station?"

The assistant will use the details you taught it and give a practical answer.

You'll know it worked when you get a sensible, location-aware answer.

---

## Step 7 — Connect a smart device (optional)
If you have a smart light or thermostat, click **Tools** in the top menu, then **Device Manager**. Look for an option like **Add Device** and follow the prompts to connect your device.

Once connected, you can ask the assistant to control it:
💬 Example:
> "Turn on the living room light."

You'll know it worked when the light turns on or off as requested.

> ⚠️ Device support depends on your hardware and brand. Not all devices work.

---

## Common mistakes
- **Installer won’t open**: Make sure you downloaded the Windows version and your PC meets the requirements.
- **Model won’t load**: Close the app, restart your PC, and try again. If it still fails, pick a smaller model from the dropdown.
- **Assistant forgets your home**: Re-teach it by typing your details again in a new chat.

---

## What this means for you

- **In everyday life**: Ask your assistant, “What’s on my calendar today?” or “Did I water the plants?” It keeps a private journal of your daily notes.
- **For your business or work**: Use it to draft emails, summarise documents, or answer FAQs about your work — all locally on your PC.
- **If you're just getting started**: Start with simple questions like “What’s the weather today?” to build trust in the assistant.

---

## Try it now
Open ChatRTX and type:
💬 Example:
> "What time is sunset today in Melbourne?"
